Answer: C
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates pneumomediastinum (lucent streaks along the mediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema in the neck) combined with bilateral peripheral reticular opacities. This specific constellation of findings—spontaneous pneumomediastinum occurring in the setting of interstitial lung disease—is a hallmark clinical presentation of Anti-MDA5 antibody-positive dermatomyositis, often associated with an organizing pneumonia or rapidly progressive ILD pattern rather than UIP.
